title: Ready for a Date with the Megastar? ‘Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse’ Coming Soon, Only on Netflix!
summary: The excitement is palpable as the fans wait to see Actor Chiranjeevi take the host’s chair in Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse, a new talk show premiering very soon only on Netflix.
body_markdown:
His entry is always preceded by whistles and thunderous applause. For 48 years, that unmistakable thrill has echoed across generations of fans. And if


‘Chira__jeevi’


made you look twice, you already know something is up. As for the missing ‘N’? It was a clue to where the Megastar was headed next.


The excitement is palpable as the fans wait to see Actor Chiranjeevi take the host’s chair in


Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse


, a new talk show premiering very soon only on Netflix.


Across from him will be some of the biggest names in cinema, sport and popular culture, ready to share stories we never knew to ask for.


But this time, audiences won’t just meet the Megastar they have known for decades. They will meet the man behind the Megastar - spontaneous, curious, witty and deeply personal, as he opens up, listens, laughs and gets candid with guests who have their own extraordinary stories to tell.


Iddhi Na Adda


(This is my turf) is what he calls it, and rightly so!


Produced by Gold Box Entertainments, Atom Media Ventures and Sol Production LLP, filming of


Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse


is now underway, with further details about the show to be announced soon. Stay tuned!


Get ready to step into


Chiranjeevi’s Megaverse


, only on Netflix. Coming Soon!
